tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt halted with a partial failure after us-east (orchestrator error), leaving the service mixed (us-east v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollback. All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate 0.002. v2.3.1 remains unhealthy in production and should not be redeployed until fixed. v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging and was not deployed. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator partial-failure.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and is healthy again, with error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002. I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release that was healthy. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging. The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the service mixed. The retry completed it.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the partial rollout, the retry, and the current state. Its summary says v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is fixed. The first incident request timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key, and it was created once.

The orchestrator partial failure and the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still need follow-up, which the incident notes.
